default/30759.htm.text: Witch Kalis: Feel the earth tremble with desire for a blood sacrifice! Hear the wind call for a hero to lead us into a new era! The time of chaos is upon us. It is time to decide what sort of man you will be.

Q00242_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul2/30759-0.text: Witch Kalis: I owe the Mysterious Dark Knight a favor, so I'll help you. I need to use the Sight of One-Hundred Eyes spell to find the owner of this hair. I'm missing some key ingredients, though.
Witch Kalis: Find Matild to get the materials for the spell. Aren't you supposed to be in a hurry?
Witch Kalis: Good work. Now wait a moment while I cast the spell...
Witch Kalis: Aren't you supposed to be in a hurry?

Q00501_ProofOfClanAlliance/30759-01.html.text: Witch Kalis: Would you choose to be a star shining brightly in the midst of chaos? Behold the graves of those who have fallen attempting to do this... Are you prepared to rest alongside them?

Q00501_ProofOfClanAlliance/30759-05.html.text: Witch Kalis: Where is the confidence you so reeked of earlier? No comrades willing to risk their lives, eh? Unless you bring me three symbols of loyalty , you will never pass the test. In order to obtain the symbols, three of your clan must take an oath of their life at the table of sacrifice and p…

Q00501_ProofOfClanAlliance/30759-06.html.text: Witch Kalis: Your comrades must have firm resolve and unfailing loyalty. In these days of the endless pursuit of profit, these are rare and noble qualities. Now, do you trust your clan members? Would you bet your life on them? If so, then drink this poison and ask your clan members to gather the in…

Q00501_ProofOfClanAlliance/30759-08.html.text: Witch Kalis: Ah, all the ingredients of the Antidote! It has been a long time since this has happened. It is heartening to learn that there are still people like you and your clan with firm resolve and common trust! You are truly the soldiers of the new age! A bright star illuminating the darkness …

Q00503_PursuitOfClanAmbition/30759-01.ht.text: Witch Kalis: You who will walk the path of a king, listen carefully! Ambition and power will guide your fate!

Q00242_PossessorOfAPreciousSoul2/30759-0.text: Witch Kalis: Find my disciple Matild at my hut, in the forest east of the Ivory Tower in Oren. Tell her you need the materials for the Sight of One-Hundred Eyes spell.
Witch Kalis: I've found a very faint trace of the Lady of the Lake in the Valley of Saints. Her life force is weakening. You'd better hurry!

Q00501_ProofOfClanAlliance/30759-02.html.text: Witch Kalis: You fool! Do you think that you are immortal? The test begins! Are there any among your clan who would die for you?

Q00501_ProofOfClanAlliance/30759-03.html.text: Witch Kalis: Ah, we shall see... Tell those who would lay down their lives for you to join me at the table of sacrifice ! If they are truly loyal they will not hesitate to sacrifice their lives. Bring me three symbols of loyalty , I will recognize the resolve of you and your clan!

Q00501_ProofOfClanAlliance/30759-04.html.text: Witch Kalis: Just as I expected. All talk and no action.

Q00501_ProofOfClanAlliance/30759-07.html.text: Witch Kalis: Tell me, how does the poison taste? Everything growing dark, is it? That would be death coming for you.
